epistemic_model.uncertainty_policy: The airless surface is one explicit realization compatible with current constraints, not a claim that the actual planet is known to be airless.

atmosphere.notes: JWST observations suggest no substantial hydrogen-rich atmosphere. Possible thin CO2 or N2 atmosphere, or none. Simulation assumes minimal/no atmosphere — agents require O2 production.

geology.bulk_composition: Iron core (~25% by mass), silicate mantle (olivine, pyroxene, perovskite), possible water ice layer
geology.tectonic_activity: Moderate — tidal stresses from close-in orbit create seismic activity at terminator zone
geology.volcanism: Possible limited volcanic activity near substellar point (tidal heating)

flare_profile.notes: TRAPPIST-1 is moderately active. Flares deliver ~3x Earth's UV flux baseline. Superflares can temporarily increase surface radiation 100x.

radiation_system.basis: No atmosphere or magnetosphere is assumed. Planetary shadow reduces direct stellar-particle exposure toward the anti-stellar side; all rates are explicit scenario priors.

biomes.name: Scorched Flats
biomes.description: Permanently sun-facing basaltic plains. Surface partially vitrified by constant stellar irradiation. Iron-rich deposits exposed by thermal fracturing.

biomes.name: Basalt Plains
biomes.description: Transitional volcanic terrain between the scorched substellar point and the temperate terminator. Dark basaltic rock with sulfurous outgassing vents. Iron oxide gives the surface a rust-red appearance.

biomes.name: Terminator Ridge
biomes.description: The narrow habitable band where day meets eternal night. Rugged terrain shaped by extreme thermal stress — fractured rock, steep ridgelines, and shallow caves formed by differential expansion. The most geologically active zone due to tidal stresses. Intermittent water condensation in sheltered crevices.

biomes.name: Frost Expanse
biomes.description: Permanently shadowed region near the anti-stellar hemisphere. Surface covered in CO2 frost and water ice deposits. Temperature drops sharply away from terminator. Occasional ice geysers where subsurface volatiles escape.

biomes.name: Deep Ice
biomes.description: The anti-stellar pole. Kilometers-thick ice sheet overlaying frozen volatiles (CO2, N2, possibly NH3). Extremely cold with zero stellar illumination. Rich in water ice and trapped carbon compounds, but conditions are near-lethal. Visibility near zero without artificial light.

resource_modifiers.notes: Resources are geographically polarized — water on the cold side, metals on the hot side. Colony site on terminator must orchestrate expeditions to both extremes.
